description: Alterations to an existing garden building. Minor works to the main (listed) building being the replacement of the existing modern front door, replacement of failing plastic guttering to the rear of the property and the insertion of a small hole (c20cm diameter) in the front basement wall to allow extract from a currently unventilated kitchen.
decision_conditions: <p>The following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the LPA prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the works:</p><p>i) details of the proposed external vent cover, including an elevation showing the location of the proposed vents, product details, size, material, colour and finish.</p><p>The work shall be carried out in accordance with the details so approved and shall be maintained as such thereafter.&nbsp;</p><p>REASON: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.&nbsp;</p>

All new works and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile unless otherwise specified in the details hereby approved. Reason: In order to protect the special interest of the listed building.

The Development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 18(a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended.
